cards.usagePattern: Parents + should + encourage children to stand independently + instead of + V-ing

variants.usagePattern: Parents + should + encourage children to stand independently + instead of + V-ing
variants.synonyms: motivate offspring to become self-reliant, nurture financial autonomy in children, urge kids to forge their own path

cards.definition: tạo ra áp lực đáp lễ ngầm cho khách mời dự tiệc

cards.partOfSpeechLabel: Cụm động từ học thuật (Collocation)

variants.example: Printing bank QR codes directly on wedding invitations can impose unspoken reciprocity on guests, transforming joyful celebrations into awkward financial transactions.

variants.sourceTitle: Bank QR codes on wedding invitations imply a 'debt repayment' expectation

variants.sourceTitle: Bank QR codes on wedding invitations imply a 'debt repayment' expectation

cards.definition: biến các dịp chung vui thành bài toán tính toán lỗ lãi

variants.example: When hosts obsess over breaking even on banquet expenses, they sadly turn social milestones into ledgers and alienate their closest friends.

variants.usagePattern: Avoid / Spark + awkward financial tallying among guests

variants.note: Danh động từ 'tallying' (kiểm đếm/so đo) tạo hình ảnh sống động và rất chuẩn xác khi nói về tiền mừng cưới. | Nguồn: Wedding incurred a loss as family of 4 gave only $40 as gift (https://e.vnexpress.net/news/business/money/wedding-incurred-a-loss-as-family-of-4-gave-only-40-as-gift-4756954.html)
variants.sourceTitle: Wedding incurred a loss as family of 4 gave only $40 as gift

variants.example: Young salaried workers often feel strained by commercialized gift norms, especially during peak wedding seasons when multiple invitations arrive each month.

variants.synonyms: burdened by transactional gifting customs, pressured by monetized present conventions, taxed by materialistic gift expectations

variants.sourceTitle: Wedding incurred a loss as family of 4 gave only $40 as gift

cards.definition: giữ thể diện gia đình thông qua những món quà giá trị

variants.definition: giữ thể diện gia đình thông qua những món quà giá trị
variants.example: In tightly knit communities, households often feel obliged to uphold family prestige through gifting even when extravagant gold presents stretch budgets.

variants.usagePattern: S + feel obliged to + uphold family prestige through gifting + even when + Clause
variants.synonyms: preserve household status via presents, maintain clan reputation through offerings, protect family standing with lavish gifts

variants.sourceTitle: My mother-in-law suggests I present gold as wedding gift to her niece

variants.usagePattern: Resent / Confront + asymmetric social gifting expectations + within + N

variants.note: Tính từ 'asymmetric' (bất đối xứng) nâng tầm độ chính xác khi mô tả sự bất công ngầm trong họ hàng. | Nguồn: My mother-in-law suggests I present gold as wedding gift to her niece (https://e.vnexpress.net/news/love/my-mother-in-law-suggests-i-present-gold-as-wedding-gift-to-her-niece-4730712.html)
variants.sourceTitle: My mother-in-law suggests I present gold as wedding gift to her niece

cards.usagePattern: Be/Feel + pressured into ostentatious generosity + by + N

variants.definition: bị thúc ép thể hiện sự hào phóng phô trương
